market.gear.title: Gear system — market ka mahaul pehle, stock baad me
market.gear.quote: इफ मार्केट सपोर्ट्स यू कैन नॉट मिस इट मार्केट का सपोर्ट बहुत जरूरी है गाइस। बहुत ही ज्यादा जरूरी है मार्केट का सपोर्ट
market.gear.gloss: "If market supports — you cannot miss it. Market ka support BAHUT zaroori hai guys. BAHUT HI ZYADA zaroori hai market ka support."

market.breakouts_working.title: Breakouts kaam kar rahe hain? — creator ka #1 thermometer
market.breakouts_working.gloss: Aaj ke breakouts ka behaviour hi kal ka thermometer hai — pop & drop ho raha hai to size chhoti.

universe.min_bars.title: Kam se kam 100 bars ka data
universe.min_bars.quote: आईपीओ स्टॉक्स में... i finance... 147.50 के ऊपर जाता है तो देखा जा सकता है
universe.min_bars.gloss: "IPO stocks me bhi — 147.50 ke upar jaata hai to dekha ja sakta hai." Yaani nayi listing bhi trade ke layak hai.
universe.min_bars.note: Naye Winners Naye IPO Me Milte Hain

universe.bse_backfill.title: NSE pe naya ticker = chhoti history — BSE se bharo (SIRF LIVE, backtest me nahi)
universe.bse_backfill.gloss: NSE ne Apr 2026 me 91 aur Aug 2026 me 158 'nayi listings' di — ye IPO nahi, BSE ki purani companies ka bulk admission tha. Unki history .BO pe hai.

universe.min_traded_value.title: Rs 5 Cr ka 20-din average turnover — sirf floor, rank bonus nahi
universe.min_traded_value.gloss: Liquidity apne CAPITAL ke hisaab se naapo. Rs 1.44 lakh ki position ke liye Rs 5 Cr turnover bilkul theek hai.

sector.heat.title: Hot sector — abhi ki definition (SURFACE-LEVEL, badalni hai)
sector.heat.quote: बट तो जो एक मोमेंटम हम चाहते हैं खासकर प्रायर मोमेंटम में कि आग लग जानी चाहिए जैसे डिफेंस में हुआ था या फिर पिछले साल रेलवे या फिर पीएसयूस में हो रहा था वैसा तो नहीं हुआ ना
sector.heat.gloss: "Jo ek momentum hum chahte hain — khaaskar prior momentum me — ki AAG LAG JAANI CHAHIYE. Jaise DEFENCE me hua tha, ya pichle saal RAILWAY, ya PSU me ho raha tha — waisa to nahi hua na."

sector.exclude_other_diversified.title: 'Other' aur 'Diversified' heat calc se bahar
sector.exclude_other_diversified.gloss: 'Other' ka matlab hai 'pata nahi'. 'Diversified' conglomerates ka jhola hai jisme koi common driver hota hi nahi — unka 'sector hot hai' jhootha signal hai.

selection.base_adaptive.title: Adaptive base window — 6 se 30 din me sabse LAMBA valid base
selection.base_adaptive.gloss: Jitna zyada consolidate hua, utna achha action on the breakout. Ek hafte ki shanti 'supply khatam' ka saboot nahi hai — isliye pick ke liye kam se kam 8 din.

selection.score.hot_sector.title: Hot sector bonus +4 — scoring ka sabse zaroori element
selection.score.hot_sector.quote: एंड इट वर्क्ड बिकॉज़ मेटल काफी हॉट थे।
selection.score.hot_sector.gloss: "And it worked BECAUSE metals kaafi hot the." — Setup pass ho gaya, phir bhi sector ka support ek ALAG gate hai.

selection.score.cap_pref.title: Small/micro tilt, large-cap ko bhaari penalty
selection.score.cap_pref.gloss: "Hum large caps trade nahi karte." Mega cap ka UPSIDE hi chhota hai — move ka size market cap se calibrate hota hai.

selection.score.near_52w.title: 52W high zone bonus +3
selection.score.near_52w.gloss: 52-week high zone me upar supply nahi hoti — line of least resistance upar hai.

selection.score.five_pct.title: 5% stock — din me 5% chal sakta hai?
selection.score.five_pct.quote: It's a 5% stock for the next five days.
selection.score.five_pct.gloss: Stock me itni jaan honi chahiye ki wo hile — warna setup theek hote hue bhi paisa nahi banta.

selection.earnings_guard.title: Result 3 din me ho to pick nahi
selection.earnings_guard.gloss: "Numbers pe leke chale gaye, loss ho gaya." Fresh breakout ko result ke aar-paar hold karna coin toss hai, setup nahi.

selection.fundamental_confidence.title: Numbers Check — dikhao, chuno mat
selection.fundamental_confidence.quote: नंबर्स अपने आप में कोई मैटर नहीं करते हैं... नंबर्स कैसे आए? सेक्टर कैसा परफॉर्म कर रहा है फंडामेंटली। एंड द सेम टाइम प्राइस एक्शन क्या मैच कर रहा है?
selection.fundamental_confidence.gloss: Fundamentals se stock chunte nahi, breakout khelte hain. Par earnings hi fuel hai ("स्टॉक प्राइसेस आर स्लेव ऑफ अर्निंग्स"), aur unka asli test numbers nahi — numbers pe MARKET ka reaction hai. 30%+ growth wala bar creator ka apna hai.

selection.max_picks.title: Roz sirf TOP-2 picks
selection.max_picks.quote: एक दो पोजीशन ली। स्टॉक इज़ अप लाइक 10-20%, ऐसे तीन चार स्टॉक मिल गए — यू आर लाइक 25% इन्वेस्टेड, दे आर डन।
selection.max_picks.gloss: "Ek-do position li. Stock is up like 10-20%, aise teen-chaar stock mil gaye — you are like 25% invested, they are done."

entry.trigger.title: Entry = pivot cross. Bas. Volume ki shart NAHI.
entry.trigger.gloss: Stop-buy pivot pe lagta hai. Us waqt poore din ka volume pata hi nahi hota — isliye wo shart lag hi nahi sakti.

exit.stop_loss.title: SL — swing low ya pivot se ~3.5-4.5% neeche
exit.stop_loss.quote: सो मुझे लगता है कि जो सबसे टफेस्ट थिंग होती है ना स्टॉक मार्केट में वो होती है स्टॉप लॉस को फॉलो करना क्योंकि 99% ट्रेडर्स भी नहीं कर पाते हैं गाइस।
exit.stop_loss.gloss: "Sabse toughest cheez stock market me hoti hai STOP LOSS ko FOLLOW karna — kyunki 99% traders bhi nahi kar paate hain guys."

exit.book_at_10.title: +10% pe 50% book, baaki trail
exit.book_at_10.quote: जैसे ही आप डबल डिजिट में आए तो आप 1/3 या 50% बुक कर लें। बाकी आप 10 डे से ट्रेल करते रहे।
exit.book_at_10.gloss: "Jaise hi aap DOUBLE DIGIT me aaye to aap 1/3 ya 50% book kar lein. Baaki aap 10 DE se trail karte rahein."

exit.trail_40dma.title: 40 DMA trail (creator 10 DMA bolta hai — kyun nahi, ye padho)
exit.trail_40dma.quote: जहां पे भी 10-12% का आए आप 50% बुक करके बाकी 10 डे पे ट्रेल कर सकते हैं
exit.trail_40dma.gloss: "Jahan pe bhi 10-12% ka aaye, aap 50% book karke baaki 10 DE pe trail kar sakte hain."

risk.cash_constraint.title: Cash constraint — jitna paisa hai utni hi position
risk.cash_constraint.gloss: Rs 1 lakh me 29 positions ek saath nahi khul sakti.

risk.qty_floor.title: Math.floor — ek share bhi na aaye to trade skip
risk.qty_floor.gloss: MRF/Page jaise Rs 1.5 lakh ke share ka 1 share zabardasti 'khareedna' chhupa hua leverage tha.

risk.ramp.title: Risk ramp — cash se nikalte waqt aadhi size
risk.ramp.quote: हमने कुछ एक ट्रेड्स ली टू टेस्ट कि मार्केट कैसा है। अगर यहां पर हमें सफलता मिलती है, ईजीनेस महसूस होता है, तो हम आगे जाएंगे। हम गियर अप करेंगे।
risk.ramp.gloss: "Humne kuch ek trades li TO TEST ki market kaisa hai. Agar yahan par humein safalta milti hai, easiness mehsoos hota hai, to hum aage jaayenge. Hum GEAR UP karenge."

sizing.flat_24.title: Har trade 24% of capital (flat)
sizing.flat_24.quote: And we are taking the BEST OF THE BEST few stocks, GOOD POSITION SIZE
sizing.flat_24.gloss: "Hum best of the best chand stocks le rahe hain, ACHHI POSITION SIZE ke saath — aur usi ke andar entry, re-entry kar rahe hain."

sector.heat.persistence.title: "Aag lag jaani chahiye" ko sector-gate banana (TEST FAIL)
sector.heat.persistence.quote: बट तो जो एक मोमेंटम हम चाहते हैं खासकर प्रायर मोमेंटम में कि आग लग जानी चाहिए जैसे डिफेंस में हुआ था या फिर पिछले साल रेलवे या फिर पीएसयूस में हो रहा था वैसा तो नहीं हुआ ना
sector.heat.persistence.gloss: "Aag lag jaani chahiye — jaise DEFENCE me hua tha, ya pichle saal RAILWAY, ya PSU me. Waisa to nahi hua na." Farak AVDHI aur BREADTH ka hai: ek-do din ka move ek REACTION hai.

sector.pack_breakout.title: Poore pack ka ek saath breakout — sector-move ka sabse saaf signal
sector.pack_breakout.quote: इन दिस पर्टिकुलर पॉइंट, 2022 के अंदर हम बात कर रहे हैं — दिस टाइम, उस टाइम आप देख सकते हैं कि सारे साथ में ही ब्रेकआउट हुए थे।
sector.pack_breakout.gloss: "Us time aap dekh sakte hain ki SAARE SAATH ME HI breakout hue the." Ek naam ka breakout ek trade hai; poore pack ka ek hafte me breakout ek SECTOR-MOVE hai — aur wo bahut zyada bada hota hai.

sector.abandon_dead.title: Jo sector chhod dena hai — declining 200 DMA, 50 DMA reclaim nahi
sector.abandon_dead.gloss: Jo stock declining 200 DMA cross nahi kar paa raha aur 50 DMA reclaim nahi kar raha — market kitna bhi upar jaaye — wo agle 3-4-5 saal tak leader nahi banega. Usme 30-85% bounce aa sakta hai, par wo TREND nahi hai.

selection.leader_rank.title: Hot-sector bonus ko sector-leadership se weight karna (TEST FAIL — sabse bura)
selection.leader_rank.quote: BUT it was NOT the market leader, and it was NOT the best of the best name.
selection.leader_rank.gloss: "2024 me hum Shree Digvijay Cement buy kar rahe the. IT IS ALSO A GOOD BASE... par wo market leader NAHI tha. Mujhe R Power lena chahiye tha — it is a better chart. Kyunki jab ye move karta hai to KAAFI SOLID move karta hai. But I did not. So it was a MISTAKE."

selection.relative_strength.title: Index ke saamne relative strength — abhi bilkul nahi hai
selection.relative_strength.gloss: Market gire aur stock UPAR jaaye — market -10%, stock +22%. Ye chhota investor nahi kar sakta; ye bade paise ki conviction hai. Girte market me jo strength dikhate hain, wahi agle cycle ke leaders hote hain (Darvas).

selection.delivery_pct.title: Delivery % — data aa raha hai, score me nahi hai
selection.delivery_pct.gloss: Volume batata hai kitna trade hua; delivery % batata hai kitna SACH ME haath badla. 50%+ = strong haath. Bhaav upar + delivery patli = red flag. Breakout wale din high volume + high delivery = sabse bharosemand breakout.

selection.speed_veto.title: Slow mover reject — har quality shart poori hone ke baad bhi
selection.speed_veto.quote: आई एम नॉट बाइंग रेडिको खैतान। रेडिको खैतान इज़ अ पिक्चर परफेक्ट फाइव स्टार टेक्स्ट बुक बेस्ट ऑफ़ द बेस्ट स्टॉक फ्रॉम वन ऑफ़ द बेस्ट सेक्टर्स
selection.speed_veto.gloss: "I am not buying Radico Khaitan. Radico Khaitan is a picture perfect five star textbook best-of-the-best stock from one of the best sectors." — aur phir bhi NAHI, sirf isliye ki SLOW MOVER hai.

selection.a_plus_scorecard.title: A+ trade ka scorecard — 6 shartein + market ka saath
selection.a_plus_scorecard.quote: सब चीज़ बढ़िया में क्यू पावर में पिक्चर परफेक्ट टेक्स्ट बुक फाइव स्टार बेस्ट ऑफ द बेस्ट सेक्टर बेस्ट ऑफ द बेस्ट स्टॉक न्यू आईपीओ परफेक्ट एंट्री गुड पोजीशन आज
selection.a_plus_scorecard.gloss: "Sab cheez badhiya — Q Power me picture perfect, textbook, FIVE STAR, best of the best SECTOR, best of the best STOCK, NEW IPO, perfect entry, good position."

universe.ipo_base_path.title: Naye IPO ke liye MIN_BARS ghatana (TEST FAIL)
universe.ipo_base_path.gloss: Nayi listing me upar koi phansa hua nahi hota (overhead supply nahi), par history patli hoti hai. A+ scorecard ka point #4 hi 'NEW IPO' hai.

rejected.entry_volume_confirm.title: Entry pe volume confirmation (1.2x avg)
rejected.entry_volume_confirm.gloss: Breakout volume ke saath hona chahiye — sach hai, par ORDER BHARTE WAQT wo pata nahi hota.

rejected.prior_move.title: Prior-move filter (>=20% / 40% / 60%)
rejected.prior_move.gloss: "Prior momentum chahiye" — transcripts me hai, par fixed gate banate hi ulta padta hai.

rejected.no_chase.title: No-chase gate (pivot se 2% / 3% se zyada door nahi)
rejected.no_chase.gloss: "Breakout se 4%+ extended stock chase mat karo" — insaan ke liye theek, gate ke roop me nuksaan.

rejected.liquidity_tiers.title: Liquidity floor Rs 15 Cr / Rs 25 Cr
rejected.liquidity_tiers.gloss: Uski liquidity ki shikayat USKI capital ke liye thi — humari Rs 1.44 lakh ki position ke liye Rs 5 Cr theek hai.

rejected.overhead_supply.title: Overhead supply 30% gate
rejected.overhead_supply.gloss: "Upar phansa hua maal" ek asli cheez hai — par wo chart pe CONTEXT ke saath dikhta hai.

discretion.benefit_of_doubt.title: Market leaders ko benefit of doubt
discretion.benefit_of_doubt.gloss: Leader wahi stock hai jisme institutional participation LAGATAAR hai. Uska ek din ka jhatka aur ek aam stock ka jhatka ek cheez nahi hai.

discretion.cute_things.title: "Cute things" — leaders ke pullback pe chhoti entries
discretion.cute_things.gloss: Leaders ke pullback pe wo chhoti entries jinke liye uske paas KOI FORMAL EXPLANATION NAHI hai.

discretion.chart_quality.title: "Ajeeb sa chart hai" — nazron se hata do
discretion.chart_quality.gloss: Chart ki shakl ka faisla aankh se hota hai. Code ke paas aankh nahi hai.

instrument.picks_report.title: Pichhle picks ka report card — "kal jo diye the, unka kya hua?"
instrument.picks_report.gloss: Creator ka #1 signal "breakouts working?" poore MARKET ke liye hai. Ye uska PERSONAL version hai: hamare apne picks chal rahe hain ya nahi.

instrument.watchlist_tracker.title: Watchlist ka report card — ranking predictive hai ya nahi
instrument.watchlist_tracker.gloss: Watchlist roz naye sire se banti hai, to kisi ko yaad hi nahi rehta ki us naam ka aage hua kya.

lesson.already_moved_axis.title: "Kitna pehle hi chal chuka hai" — is axis pe score CALIBRATED hai, mat chhedo
lesson.already_moved_axis.gloss: Score pehle se "tight base, pivot ke paas" ko inaam deta hai. Us axis pe aur zor lagana — kisi bhi taraf — nuksaan karta hai.

risk.last4_thermometer.title: Market ka thermometer index nahi — tumhari pichhli 4 trades
risk.last4_thermometer.quote: इंडेक्स ऑल टाइम हाई लगा रहा है, नहीं लगा रहा है — ये सब चीजें क्या मैटर नहीं करती? आप इंडेक्स ट्रेडर हो क्या?
risk.last4_thermometer.gloss: "Index all-time high laga raha hai ya nahi — ye sab matter nahi karta. AAP INDEX TRADER HO KYA?" Uski jagah asli sawaal: "aapki last 4 trades kaisi thi? Usme paisa bana hai kya? Wo aapko EASY feel kara rahi hain ki TOUGH?"

lesson.noise_floor.title: Is backtest ka SHOR-STAR: ~30 point se kam farak ko nateeja mat maano
lesson.noise_floor.gloss: 5 saal me 367 trades, aur 53 mahino me se SIRF 3 mahine net profit ka 38% dete hain (5 mahine = 54%).

lesson.concentration_is_the_edge.title: Zyada trade pakadna madad nahi karta — edge CONCENTRATION me hai
lesson.concentration_is_the_edge.quote: And we are taking the BEST OF THE BEST few stocks, GOOD POSITION SIZE
lesson.concentration_is_the_edge.gloss: "Hum best of the best CHAND stocks le rahe hain, ACHHI POSITION SIZE ke saath."

lesson.verify_your_own_plumbing.title: Nateeja ulta lage to PEHLE apna code shak karo, strategy ko baad me
lesson.verify_your_own_plumbing.gloss: Gurjot: "kahin galti hai bhai, scan ke baad strategy clear hui — return me itna major change negative nahi ho sakta." Wo sahi tha.

lesson.dirty_data_didnt_flip_verdicts.title: Ganda data magnitude badalta hai, DISHA nahi — par footnote zaroor badal deta hai
lesson.dirty_data_didnt_flip_verdicts.gloss: 5 reject contaminated cache pe nikle the. Clean data pe 30 runs dobara chalaye — paanchon ka verdict WAHI raha.

lesson.52w_on_young_is_not_a_bug.title: Young stock ka "52W high" = ALL-TIME high — ye bug nahi, ye SIGNAL hai
lesson.52w_on_young_is_not_a_bug.gloss: 100-bar wale stock me max(h[-252]) asal me 100 din ka high hota hai. Ye galti nahi — us stock ka ALL-TIME high wahi hai, aur "upar koi phansa hua nahi" ka matlab bilkul wahi hai.
